summary: Phase 2 validation completed: Candidate Status Pipeline and Smart Folders functionality fully tested. All 12 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified for status dropdown, status history modal, status transitions, and Smart Folders navigation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 Status Pipeline and Smart Folders validated. Key verifications: 1) GET /api/status-config returns valid transitions for all statuses. 2) PUT /api/candidates/{id}/status validates transitions (invalid transitions return 400). 3) GET /api/candidates/{id}/status-history returns history with from_status, to_status, changed_by_name, changed_at, notes. 4) Smart Folders PROCESO exist: 'En Evaluación', 'Recién Ingresados', 'Listos para Enviar'. 5) Folder counts update correctly when status changes. 6) Sidebar is scrollable with overflow-y-auto. 7) Status dropdown shows only valid transitions from current status. 8) Status history modal shows all changes with timestamps and notes.

TestStatusConfig.test_get_status_config: PASS - Returns statuses and transitions, qualified transitions include ready_to_send, rejected, on_hold

TestStatusPipeline.test_get_status_history: PASS - History has 11 entries with proper structure
TestStatusPipeline.test_status_change_with_notes: PASS - Notes saved in history correctly

TestSmartFolders.test_get_all_folders: PASS - Returns verticals and process categories
TestSmartFolders.test_process_folders_exist: PASS - Found 'En Evaluación', 'Recién Ingresados', 'Listos para Enviar'
TestSmartFolders.test_process_folder_counts: PASS - All folders have candidate_count field
TestSmartFolders.test_folder_by_id: PASS - Can retrieve folder by ID

TestStatusFolderIntegration.test_status_change_updates_folder_counts: PASS - Folder counts update when status changes
